name: plan-meter
description: Your plan usage at the bottom right of Claude Code: 5-hour session, weekly window and an estimated month (M), calibrated from your own transcripts.

showMonth.title: Show the month (M)
showMonth.description: The plan has no monthly quota: M is this month's tokens measured against the weekly limit calibrated from your transcripts, scaled to the month's days.

countCacheRead.title: Count cache reads
countCacheRead.description: Count cache_read tokens when calibrating and summing the month. Off by default: re-reading the context dominates the total and hides the real work.
